description: This file defines the StateObserver class, a plugin for the WPEFramework that provides an interface to get device property values and set up event listeners for state changes. It includes constants for system properties, class declarations, and method signatures related to state observation and event handling.

classes.name: StateObserver
classes.description: A plugin class inheriting from AbstractPlugin that manages device state observation, property retrieval, event registration, and notification within the WPEFramework.
